name: bijaku2
about: bijaku (微弱, weak) 2: curve k = 2 of the eleven of Sec. 26 (October (2026)#Y-0NbRU, Fig. 0NNbp), the case of sanjin, gamma_sigma = 75393/994361 g = 0.7582 gamma_a (gamma_a = 0.1 g; g2(P->0) = 0.9333), on the log series P_i = 0.001 x 500^(i/24) g, i = 0..24 (0.001-0.5 g, 25 pumps, 8.9 a decade, each to 3 significant digits) (Fabrice, 15 Nov 2026: 'let's prepare a Psigma log series at small pumpings, until 0.5', 'with pilot to check convergence issues, not computing very nearby 0.3-0.4% off pumps and having 0.502 counting as 0.5; this should run together with the ongoing hokan, same priority, running in //'); the pumps of the case done already within 0.5 % stand for 1 of its points (0.5 by sanjin's 0.502 g); first a pilot of 1 pump (0.001 g), then the series (added by --zoen once the pilot has spoken, code/bijaku_pilot.py); code/bijaku_specs.py 1.0
